review_stage: aggregate reports and source implementation; one of four requested raw trajectory pairs verified from complete prefix CAS objects; complete archive restore pending

inference.interpretation: The 16 development sources have mean zero; two of four one-pair retention-validation sources have mean one. Equal-source mean 0.10 differs from equal-pair mean 2/84. Under the frozen stratified empirical bootstrap, resampling four validation sources yields no positive source with probability 0.0625, so a 5th-percentile lower bound of zero is expected. This is not a coverage guarantee; source independence remains unauthenticated.

mechanism.deletion_scope: logical read exclusion, not physical snapshot erasure

limitations: Retention contrast measures within-episode working-state candidate retention, not cross-session source-memory benefit.
The 84 pairs include correlated cases within 20 sources; 16 development sources contribute five pairs each and four retention-validation sources one pair each.
Each retention arm has 16 initial-correct no-op successes; initially-incorrect results are 14/68 versus 12/68. Neither retention win is no-op or bypass.
Selector results include 10 no-op successes in each arm and one public-rule bypass success; candidate-mediated deliveries are 10 versus 3, not 21 versus 13.

The selector loss has correct candidate selection in both arms and is classified as delivery_failure in public_rule; raw action and artifact inspection is needed before claiming a rendering, OCR, or writing cause.
Report bounds with identical endpoints describe missing-label identification bounds, not sampling confidence intervals.
Selector paired report explicitly does not estimate sampling uncertainty and retains source-group dependence; do not infer significance from the 54-pair denominator.
Source rosters are disjoint between these campaigns, but provider authenticity, source independence, and sealed confirmatory status are not established.
Full costs, provider charges, energy, production adoption, and complete independent-owner recovery remain unqualified.

Mechanism revoked_snapshot uses the same before-update snapshot as stale_snapshot; it confirms persistence of invalidation after both operations, not an isolated latest-version revoke-snapshot effect.

raw_trajectory_review.evidence_boundary: Complete CAS objects obtained from a truncated but version-pinned prefix; every reviewed file matched the independently supplied manifest SHA256 and byte count. The complete archive SHA256 has not been verified.

completed_pair_reviews.interpretation: In this date-only task, both arms begin with empty output and execute the same preparation and ROI read. The ROI OCR loses the correct date present in the overview. At step 2 bounded offers 42 candidates and selects the date 11/08/2017 retained from step 1; current_only offers only the one incorrect current OCR string. Each writes its selected text; the frozen evaluator scores the bounded text correct and the current-only text incorrect. This is within-episode candidate retention and is neither an initial no-op nor a text-delivery bypass. It is not evidence of cross-session episodic/source-memory benefit.

raw_trajectory_review.selector_loss_and_bypass_action_cause: UNRESOLVED: their raw trajectories are unavailable in the verified prefix. Aggregate reports still support delivery_failure for the loss and non-text-write success for the bypass; do not infer a crop, OCR, rendering, or write cause.
